summary: Add an image button to the board toolbar

entries.summary: Add an image button at the end of the board toolbar's tools. It opens a file picker for pictures and uploads each picked file as an image shape, in a row centered on the view. The button is disabled on a board that takes no picture files, such as a read-only board or an editor without upload or without `BoardImageKit`. The board now depends on `use-file-picker`.

Fix the board toolbar cutting off its end buttons on a narrow board. A group wider than the board now wraps its buttons, so a phone shows every control. The tool lock moves into the tools group, before the image button.
